### retail_ext_catch_up_payment
- Hub `customer_catch_up_payment`: scope, posting sentence plus allocation replaced_by, both prerequisite sentences verbatim, user-tool hand-over.
- Baseline `catch_up_amount_computation`: pull-ahead share 0 %; past due + share × one monthly payment, rounded; never below zero.
- Factors:
  - cpf_fee_settlement → late charge in the last 1 month: no autopay → whole fees due; autopay → up to 30.00 (in figures); otherwise nothing.
  - cpf_repeat_pull → ≥2 late charges and no autopay → 50; otherwise ≥1 → 25; otherwise 0.
  - cpf_lease_pull → `lease_lateness_pull_ahead`: lease late charge in 3 months → 20; in 12 but not 3 → 10; otherwise 0. "The lease need not be active" is a derivation from a source that sets no status condition; compute `XCOUNT('lease', …)` has no status filter.
  - cpf_overdue_interest → days beyond grace ≥5 → every day; 1-4 → one day; otherwise none. The per diem uses 365.
- The assembly (pull points combined, applied once and rounded, other amounts added) is entailed.
- PASS.
